reference.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: final ordinary forest boar game sprite reference.
Input image: Image 1 is the approved boar design. Modify only the legs and mane.
Primary request: make all FOUR legs cuter: short plump rounded little legs, about 25% shorter than currently, with softly rounded bean-like feet and only gentle knee/hock bends. Preserve their anatomically correct attachment under shoulder and rump and the existing two overlapping pairs: near front, far front, near hind, far hind. All four feet remain separately visible. No sharp zigzag hocks, no long straight stilts, no extra legs, no four evenly spaced pegs. Keep the overall torso and head dimensions unchanged.
Mane: fill the existing short two-tuft ridge on the upper back with a solid DARK CHOCOLATE BROWN #523323, clearly distinct from the medium-brown body. Extend that dark fill only a small distance below the ridge as one compact mane patch. Keep the mane very small and simple. Do not add extra spikes or fur strands.
Keep everything else exactly: left facing view, body proportions, short torso, lowered head, small ears, dot eye, snout, one small tusk, tiny tail, outline thickness. Flat unlit cartoon, no gradients or texture.
Palette: outline #201B18; body #A96D47; underside/far legs #784A33; mane #523323; snout #EAC084; tusk #FFF0C5. Every region is a single uniform opaque fill. Edge antialiasing only.
Full body centered on a truly transparent square background. No text, ground, shadow, labels or effects.

postprocessAuthorization: 이전 턴에서 승인한 Pillow 고정 팔레트 평탄화를 같은 스타일의 적용용 클립에 유지함.

postprocess.normalization: 클립마다 기준 포즈로 생성 줌을 통일. 한 클립 안에서는 공통 배율 사용. 슬라임 걷기는 면적 중간값으로 줌을 맞춰 눌림·늘어남 보존.

orientation.method: 각 정사각 프레임 내부만 수평 반전. 프레임 순서·알파·RGB 값을 그대로 유지.
